content.text: Your map.json is not one valid JSON object, or does not satisfy the output schema. Merge any concatenated JSON fragments into exactly one JSON object, preserving your existing object claims; do not infer new objects. The frame must be start_camera_xy (coordinates relative to the INITIAL camera), units must be meters, and objects must be an array. Fix only the schema using your existing evidence. Do not acquire new observations. Do not label coordinates in another reference frame as start coordinates. Save /work/map.json and finish.
